Recipe converged: two consecutive from-scratch 'devbox up buzztest' runs green (ansible 0 failed, TLS-verified liveness, agent active), each followed by a functional test where the Claude agent answered an @mention ('42') over the relay. Iterations fixed: Hetzner capacity (owner chose qm-devbox teardown), Host-based community routing 404 (agent now wss://buzz_host + /etc/hosts loopback pin), staging certs dropped (buzz-acp rustls webpki roots reject them). Box left RUNNING pending owner keep/destroy decision.

Epic complete: devbox-buzz repo (public, github.com/korjavin/devbox-buzz) provisions a Hetzner/DO box with self-hosted block/buzz relay (Caddy TLS, closed relay keyed to owner pubkey in stash) + Claude Code agent via buzz-acp/claude-agent-acp with CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN. Proven reproducible 2x from scratch with live agent replies. Known deferrals: sprig-latest rolling tag (pin sprig-v* when upstream tags), one agent per host, no snapshot-based fast rebuild.

Merged PR #6: README section on desktop local agents. Findings: 'Adapter needed' = CLI found, ACP adapter missing; app's Install button is self-contained (private Node + npm prefix under ~/Library/Application Support/Buzz, 15-min ceiling, no cancel — spinner usually still downloading); manual fix: npm i -g @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp, no conflict with app installer. PATH probe order documented (login shell — .zprofile not .zshrc). Source-cited; not run on macOS (flagged).

Merged PR #7: buzz-pair-relay service added to compose.caddy.yml (entrypoint override, no host publish), Caddy routes /pair* to it, env advertises BUZZ_PAIRING_RELAY_URL=wss://host/pair (same domain — no DNS changes), Caddy reload handler on bundle change. Root cause: desktop reads pairing_relay_url from NIP-11, fell back to wss://host/pair which nothing served; upstream only runs pair-relay in helm charts, never compose. Applied live to buzztest without host recreation; /pair serves (executor observed 101 upgrade; architect re-verified non-404 + NIP-11 advert). Deferred: no real phone scan test.
